capabilities.name: tag.context.overview
capabilities.use: Confirm the nexus and the caller's role.

capabilities.name: aletia.search
capabilities.use: Find the contract and related documents the caller may see.

capabilities.name: tag.policy.legal_playbook.read
capabilities.use: Approved jurisdiction-specific playbook, severity scale and delegation rules.

capabilities.name: tag.review.request
capabilities.use: Route the review to the person or role the delegation rules name.

capabilities.name: tag.signature.request
capabilities.use: After approval, and only when an authorized person asks: send the contract for signature.

capabilities.name: tag.evidence.attach
capabilities.use: Record the contract version, playbook version and review output.

inputs.name: organization, acting principal, mandate, nexus, correlation id
approved playbook for the contract type and governing jurisdiction, with delegation rules
inputs.source: tag.policy.legal_playbook.read, or an approved document the user identifies

inputs.name: organization's side, deadline, focus areas, deal context

outputs.name: contract review report
outputs.description: Clause-by-clause analysis, deviations, redlines, impact, strategy, routing, review basis.

outputs.name: neutral issues list
outputs.description: Produced instead of a classified review when no approved playbook is available.

conditions: Always before anyone relies on the review; it is not legal advice.
Every deviation the delegation rules escalate.
Any review made without an approved playbook for the contract's jurisdiction.
A signature request only after the approval the delegation rules require; signing is a person's act.
